candidates.reason: This is a centred shrink of the square, not a new layout. The logo, phone, headline and CTA are all reduced to a narrow middle column. The CTA and logo are now small. There is about 75px of dead orange below the CTA, and both sides are empty. The structure is faithful and nothing collides.

The left/right split falls apart. The logo floats alone at the top of an empty left circle. The NEW FLAVOR badge is stranded bottom-left, far from the phone it should label. The headline is pushed to the right edge with almost no margin and clips into the beige circle behind the phone. The two halves read as unrelated fragments.

The headline and CTA are strong on the right, but the product has been made trivial. The phone is shrunk to a tiny thumbnail jammed at the bottom-left edge. The NEW FLAVOR badge is too small to read, and it sits in an empty circle away from the phone. The left half is mostly dead space with weak content.

This is the best use of the shape: a larger phone, headline and CTA with a clear top-to-bottom order. But the NEW FLAVOR badge is cut off from the phone, far right in a large empty circle. That leaves the composition lopsided with a blank left third. The CTA sits only about 36px from the bottom edge, and the logo is small.
